senses.gloss: तुषार-, तुहिन- and प्रलेय- + अद्रि तुषार-, तुहिन- and प्रालेय- + अद्रि, m. Himālaya.
तुषार-, तुहिन- + कण तुषार-, तुहिन- + कण, m. a flake of snow, Kathās. 19, 50; Amar. 54.
तुषार- + किरण तुषार- + किरण, m. the moon, Śiś. 9, 27.
तुषार- + गिरि तुषार- + गिरि, m. the Himālaya, MBh. 13, 836.
तुश् तुश्, i. 1, Ātm. To sprinkle (ved.).

तुष् तुष्, i. 4, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., or refl. pass., Bhāg. P. 1, 5, 8).
 1. To be calmed (properly, to be silent, cf. तूष्णीम्), MBh. 3, 1109.
 2. To be satisfied, Man. 2, 228.
 3. To be content, Hit. i. d. 134.
 4. To be pleased, Man. 3, 207; with the gen., MBh. 1, 8361; with the dat., Kathās. 24, 195; with the instr., MBh. 4, 291; with the loc., Pañc. iii. d. 155.
 5. To satisfy, MBh. 1, 4198.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. तुष्ट, Content, satisfied, pleased, MBh. 4, 291.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. तुष्य, Easily to be satisfied, Hariv. 14882.
 --Caus.
 1. To appease, MBh. 5, 7391.
 2. To satisfy, Mārk. P. 26, 37.
 3. To gladden, Pañc. 38, 3. Anomalous absolutive, तोष्य, MBh. 1, 160.
 --With the prep. परि परि,
 1. To be completely satisfied, Bhāg. P. 6, 18, 67; Rām. 2, 2, 33.
 2. To be much pleased, Bhartṛ. 2, 2.
 --Caus.
 1. To satisfy completely, Rām. 6, 104, 28.
 2. To flatter, Pañc. 38, 22.
 --With प्र प्र, Caus. To satisfy, Bhāg. P. 4, 30, 1.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To be content, MBh. 12, 6283.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To be calmed, Bhartṛ. 3, 4.
 2. [] To be satisfied, content, MBh. 13, 220.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. संतुष्ट, Easy to be satisfied, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 277.
 --Comp.
 --Caus.
 1. To appease, Pañc. 101, 11.
 2. To please, to gladden, MBh. 3, 13685.
 --Cf. Lat. taceo; Goth. thahan.
† तुस् तुस्, i. 1, Par. To sound.
† तूष् तूष्, i. 1, Par. To be satisfied; see तुष्.
तुष तुष, m. The husk of grain, especially rice, Man. 4, 78.

तुषार तुष् + आर,
 I. adj., f. रा, Cold, Naiṣ. 3, 93.
 II. m.
 1. Mist, MBh. 9, 3632.
 2. Thin rain, Ragh. 2, 13.
 3. Dew, Śāk. d. 115.
 4. Hoar frost, Ṛt. 4, 1.
 5. Snow, Megh. 53.
 6. see तुखार.

तुषित तुषित (originally ptcple. of the pf. pass. of तुष्),
 I. m.
 1. pl. A class of subordinate deities, MBh. 13, 1371.
 2. Epithet of Viṣṇu, MBh. 12, 12864.
 II. f. ता, A proper name, Bhāg. P. 8, 1, 21.
तुष्टि तुष्टि, i. e. तुष् + ति, f. Satisfaction, Man. 2, 6.
तूष्णीक तूष्णीक, i. e. तूष्णीम् + क, adj. Taciturn, Rām. 2, 117, 3 Gorr. ˚कम्, adv. Silently, Rām. 5, 1, 97.
तूष्णीम् तूष्णीम्, i. e. तुष् + न + ई + म्, adv. Silently, MBh. 12, 3839; Man. 8, 147.
तूष्णींभाव तूष्णींभाव, i. e. तूष्णीम्-भाव, m. Silence, MBh. 12, 3840.
